version.changelog: Update registry description to remove incorrect MCP/OpenClaw integration claims

llm.summary: This skill is mostly a local file generator, but its file-writing behavior is broader than its own documentation says.

dimensions.detail: Writing project scaffolding is proportionate to the purpose, but unconfined log paths and symlink-following overwrites make the effective filesystem authority broader than disclosed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No installer, package manager activity, remote downloads, or external dependencies were found; the skill is a standalone Python script with local templates.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill claims file operations are limited to the specified project directory, but the code accepts an arbitrary --log-file path and writes fixed output files without resolving or rejecting symlinks, so writes can occur outside the declared project boundary.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill does not install services, background workers, schedulers, hooks, or privilege escalation, but the files it creates persist in the project and its generated text implies automation that is not actually installed.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose of creating an ai-team folder and Markdown configuration files matches the main script, but generated progress and workflow text overstates the result as deployed automation, runtime logs, scheduled tasks, and monitoring even though the code only creates static files.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill before installing if you need strict filesystem containment. Use it only on project directories you trust, avoid running it with elevated privileges, avoid external --log-file paths, and treat the generated ai-team files as documentation scaffolding rather than actual running AI automation.
llm.findings:
[T09] unexpected: Accepted as a material concern: artifact code confirms project outputs and optional logs can write outside the intended project scope through symlinks or an arbitrary log-file path.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Partially accepted: the generated documentation claims automation and monitoring are active, while inspected code only writes static Markdown and JSON files.
[AST4] expected: Downgraded: subprocess use appears in test files invoking the CLI with argument lists, not in runtime skill logic or shell-based command construction.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded: Chinese is the disclosed default and an English CLI option exists, though some templates remain Chinese-heavy and users should expect incomplete localization.
